# Including gas 

```{r}
save_rds_path <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/VAR_analysis_fr/VAR_output/plot_irfs_rds/diff/irf'
setwd(save_rds_path)
irf_cholesky_esp <- readRDS("irf_cholesky_esp_gas_log_diff.rds")



save_rds_path <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/VAR_analysis_fr/VAR_output/plot_irfs_rds/diff/benchmark'
setwd(save_rds_path)
gen_benchmark_esp <- readRDS( "gen_benchmark_esp_gas.rds")

```


```{r}
#Plot the IRFs
irf_price_shock_esp <- plot_irf_from_gen_benchmark(
  solution = gen_benchmark_esp,
  irf_cholesky = irf_cholesky_esp,
  variable_names = c('$Q_{elec}$','$P_{elec}$',  "IPI", '$HCPI_t$', 'ECB rate'),
  shock = "price"
)
irf_price_shock_esp
```
```{r}
#Plot the IRFs
irf_gen_shock_esp <- plot_irf_from_gen_benchmark(
  gen_benchmark_esp,
  irf_cholesky = irf_cholesky_esp,
  variable_names = c('$Q_{elec}$','$P_{elec}$',  "IPI", '$HCPI_t$', 'ECB rate'),
  shock = "gen"
)
irf_gen_shock_esp
```
